answer: Each agent claims one terrace slot below a glacier and locks an 80-credit bond. The slot grants one plume sample quota per epoch, filed with serial, terrace level, and timestamp. A keeper checks the slot log against the glacier melt table; a duplicate serial, shared sample, or transferred slot burns the bond. The first filing costs 35, the kth 35+6(k-1), so the 1000th costs 6029 and 1000 fakes pay 3,032,000 plus 80,000 locked. A rented-slot ring fails because one slot yields one quota, so extra filings expose the shared serial. An honest agent pays 35 once and recovers the bond after audit.
